gbm_population_evidence.quote: To stem increasing rates of HIV among gay and bisexual men in Central-Eastern Europe

gbm_population_flag.reason: GBM here means gay and bisexual men, not glioblastoma or anti-GBM disease.

coder_notes: HIV PrEP behavioural trial; 'GBM' = gay and bisexual men. Not a glioblastoma trial. Interventions are all behavioural; PrEP is background standard of care and not a registered intervention.
